help.snippets:
argvus-snippets: type saved text into the focused window.

Usage:
  argvus-snippets                      open the picker (SUPER + ALT + N)
  argvus-snippets add NAME CONTENT     add a snippet, or replace the one with the same name
  argvus-snippets remove NAME          remove a snippet
  argvus-snippets list                 print the index and name of every snippet
  argvus-snippets open NAME|INDEX      type a snippet into the focused window
  argvus-snippets -h, --help           show this help

Example:
  argvus-snippets add "email" "you@example.com"
  argvus-snippets list
  argvus-snippets open email

Snippets are typed where the cursor is, so focus a text field first.
